judgment.notes: The 2*pi periodic domain and normalized measure reproduce the original standing convention; no condition on T, gamma or R is encoded here.
The normalized Fourier coefficient and its distributional dual interpretation specify the transform used throughout; integrability is required for the integral formula.
All real Sobolev orders, homogeneous zero-mean norms, conjugate symmetry and zero mean are explicit. Completion defines spaces, not a solution or estimate.

L2, spatial Lp and sequence measures, continuous time representatives and essential-supremum derivative norms agree with the original conventions. The L2/H0 identification is the usual extension of polynomial orthogonality.
The Fourier multiplier fixes the sign of the Airy group for every real time and every periodic distribution; no dynamical estimate is granted.
The zeroth Fourier coefficient defines the mean projection for distributions and its constant-function identification.
The nonzero and threshold projections are explicit Fourier selectors; N>=0 is a construction domain, with no algorithmic cutoff introduced.
The inverse derivative has its zero mode explicitly removed, so neither inverse multiplier divides by zero; its square is specified.

The exact quadratic formula, including both projections, signs and coefficient 1/6, matches the original. Mean-zero L2 input and tau>0 give a legitimate formula through inverse derivatives; continuity estimates are separate N005 claims.

All four cubic terms match the original, including tau/9, -1/54, -1/(27*tau), bracket orientation, and S_(s-tau). Positive tau guards division. L2 inputs give f^2 in L1 and inverse-derivative factors in H1, so the products have meaning; no convergence claim is hidden.

The recursion and twisting use the exact fixed update on mean-zero L2, positive tau and finite L. The target's specialization tau=T/L is conditional on T>0. Well-definedness and continuity are exported by N005, not supplied as an assumption.

The equation, uniqueness class, smooth-approximation convention and twist are explicit. 'For such a solution' makes v and M conditional on a solution; existence and uniqueness are separately exported by N001 and asserted in P, not granted by this definition.
The finite average and covariance are defined for tau>0 and real phases, including zero phases. For the exponential inputs the integrals exist; no ratio estimate is included.

The finite polynomial Fourier sum specifies all phases, signs, excluded pair sum and zero output. Nonzero output guards 1/k. Bounded rough-input extensions are expressly deferred to N004; no boundedness is assumed.
The third magnitude is the third largest among all four nonzero frequencies, including the dual output. Sorting ties does not change it; its reciprocal is legitimate on the specified domain.
With L2 inputs the spatial product is L1 and its derivative is a distribution; conjugation by the Airy group is defined by D005. The definition supplies no product bound.

The bilinear inverse-derivative formula and nonzero projection are explicit. On its mean-zero L2 domain the two inverse derivatives give ordinary spatial products. Bounds and the normal-form identity remain N005 conclusions.

The exact nested-projection trilinear integral is initially defined for smooth inputs; rough uses are interpreted only via the stated source estimates and N006 extensions. It asserts no unsupported multiplication rule for arbitrary distributions.
The rational exponent 23/14 is explicit and agrees with the original continuous estimates.

The two components of X(I), time derivative interpretation and interval restriction are explicit. Finite X regularity is a condition in consuming propositions, not an assumed property of every function.

The frozen stage has the original factor 1/2, step endpoints and time-independent input; the bilinear variant is specified. Actual uses have L2, H^gamma or smooth inputs, giving the distributional integral from D016; stronger stage estimates are separately exported in N007/N009.
The three gamma cases, including gamma=1/2 with exponent 1/8, agree with the original. H002 is an explicit guard and is a direct input at every declared inference using this definition.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
